constraints: a must be a numpy array

kth.description: static integer index about which to partition the array.

axis.description: static integer axis along which to partition the array; default is -1.
constraints: axis must be an integer or left unspecified (defaulted to -1)

output.description: A copy of ``a`` partitioned at the ``kth`` value along ``axis``. The entries before ``kth`` are values smaller than ``take(a, kth, axis)``, and entries after ``kth`` are indices of values larger than ``take(a, kth, axis)``
